business_model: Usage-based browser infrastructure for AI agents

technical_complexity.rationale: Evading bot detection at scale and keeping browsers self-healing is an ongoing arms race for a four-person team.

defensibility.rationale: At least ten competitors offer similar infrastructure with funding; stealth techniques are copyable and decay as sites adapt.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Unknown, company is new. Well-funded rivals were already shipping the same wedge.

market_need_then: Agent builders in 2025 and 2026 needed browsers that sites do not block; several seed rounds for browser infrastructure were announced, showing investor demand.

branding.domain_note: Company site is tilion.com per YC; aggregators also reference tilion.dev. Press spells the name Tillion in one outlet.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident product claims: Super fast and unblockable browser infra; the internet is ready to do more

brand_strength.rationale: Very new; sources show only a tagline and a Backed by YC badge, and press spells the name inconsistently.

outcome_analysis: Tilion is an active Fall 2026 company with no outcome yet. It enters a crowded browser infrastructure market with funded rivals, so its edge depends on stealth and reliability claims that were not independently verified. Funding figures online conflict and none is confirmed.
notes: Dealroom shows $125K seed, Caplight $500,000 total with an accelerator round dated 2026-08-01, and Entrepreneur Loop reports $500,000 from YC on 2026-10-19. These are aggregator or single outlet figures with conflicting dates, so not recorded as rounds. Prothom Alo says three Bangladeshi cofounders while Entrepreneur Loop says an Indian founder; nationality not recorded. Founder backgrounds were not on the YC page fetched.
